title: The learner types 'end lesson' right after the opening, with no group agreed and nothing tried: the mentor calls end_lesson, records nothing, runs no demonstration or check, and answers in at most two sentences with no new step
note: Spec 014 T108. Stop rule as the cockpit gave it 2026-11-19: 'something to record' means a demo was made or a check was run; with neither, a stop in words calls end_lesson and writes no record, even where a hand-in set the focus. This case says 'end lesson' straight after the opening, before any demo or check, so end_lesson is the expected call. Not covered (proposed, no number): a stop after a check expects record_lesson and no end_lesson; a stop in a go-deeper lesson ends on the hand-back line.
